adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the diff adds an unconditional refresh flow: it immediately `fetch`es `https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token` using the stored `refresh_token`, then `await prisma.credential.update({ ... })` before creating the `jsforce.Connection`. There is no expiry/validity check or conditional guard around this refresh+DB write, so every time this code path runs it will incur an external HTTP call and a DB update even if the existing `access_token` is still usable. This is a concrete diff-grounded latency/rate-limit concern, but not a clear correctness defect by itself.
